caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mallet with a cylindrical head and a long handle. The head of the mallet is depicted with a textured brown surface and has darker brown rims at both the top and bottom ends. There are darker lines on the head indicating grain and the cylindrical form, as well as a small oval-shaped patch on the side. The handle, extending to the right, is long, round, and tapers slightly, rendered in brown with lighter patches indicating wood grain. The background of the image is plain and uncolored, while the name "Eugene Bartz" is written in cursive at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Chalking Mallet
